dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, have you seen someone who looks like me?

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Like you? ...Oh, I see. You're looking for family.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: I haven't, no, but I will keep it in mind.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: I've been separated from family before. I know how you feel...
